themes.title: 冰饮爆裂飞溅瞬间（Iced Drink Splash）
themes.english_prompt:
Keep the exact subject identity, facial features, hairstyle, outfit, accessories, and studio environment from the reference image unchanged. Transform this portrait into a high-impact, candid, humorous 180-degree ultra-wide fisheye action snapshot, 3:4 vertical aspect ratio.

1. Subject & Scene Preservation: Single young East Asian woman with dark brown wavy half-up long hair and airy bangs, delicate oval face, wearing the exact pale ice-blue spaghetti-strap dress and the white pearl necklace with a silver Saturn orb pendant. Preserve the dreamy cool-toned pale-blue studio setting surrounded by layered sheer translucent organza drapes and the distinct butterfly-wing light projection on the upper-right fabric backdrop. Do NOT replace the studio with a street scene.
2. 180° Fisheye Perspective: Shot from a close-up, slightly high-angle tilted down with a true 180-degree fisheye lens. Extreme forced perspective where the foreground is massively magnified, the girl is in the midground, and the surrounding sheer blue curtains and butterfly light projection curve organically toward the edges with subtle natural optical circular vignetting.
3. Foreground Action & Liquid Splash: A clear glass of sparkling iced drink held close to the fisheye lens in the extreme foreground, appearing huge due to forced perspective. At the exact shutter moment, crystal-clear liquid and translucent ice cubes with internal air bubbles erupt outward in a continuous, physically accurate arc trajectory toward the camera and around the subject. Extreme close-up ice cubes near the lens, tack-sharp midground droplets refracting cool blue studio light, soft bokeh droplets in the background.
4. Candid Dynamic Expression: The girl reacts naturally and playfully to the sudden splash — laughing brightly, slightly hunching her shoulders and tilting her head back to dodge the flying droplets, eyes crinkled in genuine surprise and joy, breaking the calm pose into a hilarious candid moment.
5. Photography & Lighting: Realistic action camera photography, high-speed flash freezing the splash combined with the cool blue rim light on her hair, realistic skin pores, natural fabric folds, crisp liquid refraction. No stiff posing, no CGI look, no extra limbs or deformed fingers, no background replacement.

themes.title: 梦幻虹光泡泡暴走瞬间（Iridescent Bubble Gun Barrage）
themes.english_prompt:
Edit the supplied reference image as the SOLE reference for the person, outfit, jewelry, and studio. Create one photorealistic 3:4 vertical action portrait of the SAME young East Asian woman. Preserve her recognizable facial proportions, eye shape and spacing, nose, jawline, lips, skin tone, and natural light makeup even as her expression changes. Keep her dark-brown long half-up hair with wispy bangs, pale ice-blue spaghetti-strap dress, and white pearl necklace with the SAME silver Saturn-orb pendant (Vivienne Westwood style); keep both dress straps and the pendant visible. Preserve the cool pale-blue studio, layered translucent organza drapes, soft upper-left hair rim light, and butterfly-wing-shaped LIGHT PROJECTION on the upper-right BACKDROP. It is projected light, never physical wings. Change her pose and expression, not her identity.

Shoot from slightly above eye level, angled gently downward, through a real 180-degree diagonal-field full-frame fisheye lens. Fill the 3:4 rectangle. Show unmistakable radial barrel distortion in the peripheral drapes and extreme foreground, plus a soft circular optical vignette around the outer edge—not a pasted-on black circle. Keep her face near the optical center, clearly recognizable and relatively undistorted, with her shoulders, dress neckline, and necklace in frame. She tips her head back a little and laughs spontaneously, her eyes naturally crinkling: a funny split second caught by a friend, not a posed fashion shot.

Her anatomically connected right arm reaches from her shoulder toward the camera; her right hand grips a small translucent, lightly futuristic bubble blaster at the lower-left foreground, its visible nozzle just centimeters from the lens and greatly enlarged by perspective. Her left arm bends toward her face; one lightly soap-wetted left index fingertip gently dimples a large intact transparent bubble just in front of and slightly beside her nose. Its film remains intact, and neither the bubble nor either hand obscures her eyes, facial features, dress straps, or pendant. Her remaining left fingers curl naturally. Exactly one person, exactly two naturally jointed arms, and no more than two hands: each hand has five anatomically correct digits including one thumb, with natural finger occlusion where the blaster is gripped. No missing, fused, doubled, detached, or extra fingers, hands, or limbs.

A coherent airflow stream carries differently sized soap bubbles from the visible nozzle toward and across the lens; the closest ones appear enormous primarily because of proximity. Several OTHER bubbles burst near the lens while the fingertip-touched bubble stays intact. Their thin films retract under surface tension into fine droplets that briefly follow the airflow before falling under gravity; unburst bubbles decelerate and drift gently upward. Render delicate thin-film iridescence, subtle cool-blue studio reflections, and realistic refraction—not solid rainbow plastic spheres. A short-duration high-speed studio flash freezes crisp midground bubbles and individual microdroplets; extremely close bubbles soften naturally out of focus, while distant bubbles become bokeh. Balance the flash with the cool ambient light so the backdrop projection remains legible. Preserve real skin pores, flyaway hair strands, and luminous organza texture. No CGI sheen, additional people, outdoor replacement, drink glass, ice cubes, or unrelated liquid splashes.
themes.chinese_prompt: 以参考图为唯一人物与场景参考进行图生图重绘，输出 3:4 竖版真实摄影照片。严格保留同一位年轻东亚女性的面部辨识特征：精致鹅蛋脸、清透自然妆容、柔和眼线与淡粉唇色；保留深棕色微卷半扎长发及轻薄空气刘海、浅冰蓝色细肩带连衣裙、白色珍珠项链和银色立体土星吊坠（Vivienne Westwood 风格）。保留原图冷调淡蓝色影棚、多层半透明欧根纱帷幔、左上方发丝逆光，以及右上方纱幕上可辨认的蝴蝶翅膀光影。将镜头改为略高于人物、向下倾斜的近距离 180° 超广角鱼眼视角；她一只手将透明泡泡枪举到镜头左下方几厘米处，前景枪身因近大远小而极度放大；另一只手只用一根食指，俏皮地轻戳鼻尖前方的一颗巨大透明虹彩皂泡，微仰头、眯眼开怀大笑。泡泡枪喷口向镜头及画面中央射出密集、大小交错的皂泡，几颗在镜头前方破裂飞散出细小水珠，高速闪光定格薄膜干涉虹光与微滴。

themes.title: 仙气纱幕下的生日蛋糕偷吃抓包（Caught-in-the-Act Cake & Sparkler Burst）
themes.english_prompt:
Edit the reference image as the sole identity and setting reference, not as inspiration for a look-alike. Preserve the exact young East Asian woman's recognizable oval facial structure and proportions, natural makeup with soft eyeliner and pale-pink lips, dark-brown wavy half-up long hair with airy bangs, pale ice-blue spaghetti-strap dress, and white pearl necklace with its silver Saturn-orb pendant. Keep the cool pale-blue studio, layered translucent organza drapes, upper-left hair rim light, and recognizable butterfly-wing light projection on the upper-right backdrop. Change her action and expression, not her identity, outfit, jewelry, or studio.

Create one candid, photorealistic 3:4 vertical birthday snapshot through a true 180-degree diagonal fisheye lens, camera close and slightly above her, angled downward. Show pronounced optical barrel distortion and curved room and organza edges, with a subtle, natural circular vignette toward the frame perimeter—never a pasted-on black ring. Keep her face near the optical center so its proportions remain recognizable. She leans in, wide-eyed at being caught stealing cake, breaking into a mischievous grin; a tiny dab of whipped cream sits on her nose.

Her left hand steadies the board of one small vintage pale-blue-and-white piped whipped-cream strawberry cake near the lens but within its focusing distance. The cake fills the lower foreground through forced perspective without obscuring her face, dress straps, necklace, or the butterfly projection. Her right hand holds one fork at the side of the frame. One red strawberry and a small dollop of cream have just been flicked from the fork toward the camera; a few tiny cream flecks trail them along one coherent forward path that curves downward under gravity. Keep the fork, cake, airborne strawberry, and centered face readable and sharply focused; let the distant drapes render softly while the butterfly silhouette stays legible.

Plant one lit golden cake sparkler securely on the cake's far edge, separated from her face, hair, and sheer fabric. Its compact sparks originate only at the tip, scatter briefly outward and upward, then arc downward and fade; none touch the organza. Short-duration photographic flash freezes the moving strawberry, cream droplets, hands, and short luminous spark trails. Balance the cool studio lighting with restrained warm sparkler highlights. Render natural skin texture, moist cream, detailed strawberry flesh, and believable body mechanics.

Exactly one woman, one cake, one sparkler, and one fork. Show no more than her two naturally connected arms and two hands: left supporting the cake board, right holding the fork. Each hand has five anatomically plausible digits including a thumb, allowing realistic finger overlap and occlusion; no extra, missing, duplicated, or fused fingers, hands, or limbs. No distorted central face, plastic skin, CGI fireworks, stiff fashion pose, text, or logos.

themes.title: 冰晶银蓝蝴蝶礼炮炸裂瞬间（Silver-Blue Confetti & Butterfly Popper Explosion）
themes.english_prompt:
Edit the supplied reference image as the sole identity and setting reference. First preserve the same woman's recognizable facial proportions and delicate oval face, natural makeup with soft eyeliner and pale-pink lips, dark-brown wavy long half-up hair with airy bangs, exact pale ice-blue spaghetti-strap dress, and white pearl necklace with its silver Saturn-orb pendant. Do not replace her with a lookalike, change the outfit, or redesign the pendant. Retain the cool pale-blue studio, layered translucent organza drapes, soft upper-left hair rim light, and butterfly-wing light projection on the upper-right backdrop.

Make one candid, photorealistic 3:4 vertical action photograph through a genuine 180-degree ultra-wide fisheye lens positioned close to and slightly above her, tilted gently downward. Show strong near-to-far enlargement of the foreground popper, naturally bowed drapes at the periphery, and a soft circular optical vignette or radial edge falloff, never a pasted-on black ring. Keep her face, upper dress, and Saturn pendant legible in the crop-safe central field.

Freeze the instant one handheld party popper has just been twisted open. Its single cylindrical nozzle looms in the extreme lower-left foreground, pointed diagonally toward the lens, with the burst visibly originating inside that nozzle. Show exactly two visible hands, no more: both attached to her own two anatomically continuous arms, each hand with one natural thumb and four natural fingers, gripping and twisting that same popper without obscuring her face or pendant. No extra hands, doubled palms, disconnected arms, fused or malformed fingers, or duplicate poppers.

A coherent cone of silver and ice-blue metallic paper confetti, thin flexible translucent crystal-faceted film, and lightweight sheer blue paper butterflies shoots outward from the nozzle. Vary their launch speeds and spin; let their paths fan away from this one origin, curl and flutter in air resistance, then start arcing downward under gravity. They are not sharp broken glass, fireworks, smoke, or stationary floating ornaments. A brief high-speed flash pulse (roughly 1/10,000 second) crisply freezes the midground pieces and natural skin texture; blue backlight glints through the film and edges of the butterfly cutouts. Near-lens pieces appear oversized and partly out of focus, while farther pieces diminish into true optical bokeh. Maintain plausible highlights, shadows, depth, and occlusion.

In the midground she instinctively scrunches her shoulders, flinches playfully, winks one eye shut while the other remains visible, and breaks into an uninhibited laugh. Make her reaction spontaneous rather than posed. Preserve realistic hair strands, skin texture, dress fabric translucency, and photographic optics; avoid plastic skin, CGI sheen, altered facial features, extra people, or altered jewelry.
